<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex013112026-09-0101-14-23" status="unreviewed"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference">kha cig</rs> 
         <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3834">rgya</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3831">phya</rs> |</note> 
         <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3831">phya</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3837">g.yor</rs> |</note> 
          don dam par snang ba dang tshogs pa med kyang rang <expan>bzhin</expan> med pa nyid ma yin dgag du grub par 'dod pa yin la 
         <note type="gloss">grub lugs <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3834">rgya</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3831">phya</rs> gnyis kyang mi 'dra ba yod pa ltar de 'dir bye brag mi gzung<note type="editorial">Reading unclear</note> bar phyogs ded byed cing snang</note>  
         'di yang mi rung ste de nyid kyang dpyad mi bzod par 'gyur ba'i phyir dang | <note type="gloss">bden pas stong pa'i stong nyid ces pa bkag chos dgag bya la rag las pa las rig ngor dgag bya bden pa nyid mi 'grub pa'i phyir ro || 
         de yang <rs type="person" ana="">tsha</rs> na re kun rdzob tu bden pa bkag pa 'grub pa dgag bya grub pa la mi ltos te dgag bya don dngos sam rtag dngos med kyang de dag gis stong pa mi 'grub pa'i phyir | des na kun rdzob tu bkag pa ngos bzung ba dgag bya ngos zin pa la ltos pa yin la | don dam par bkag pa 'grub pa dgag bya grub pa la ltos pa yin pa las yang dag par dgag bya med pas de          </note>
         <rs type="person" ana="">slob dpon</rs> gyis kyang <note type="gloss"><rs type="work">rtsa sher</rs></note> <quote>
         <lg>
            <l xml:space="preserve">gal te mi stong cung zad yod || </l>
            <l xml:space="preserve">stong pa cung zad yod par 'gyur || </l>
            <l xml:space="preserve">mi stong cung zad yod min na || </l>
            <l xml:space="preserve">stong pa yod par ga la 'gyur|[ ]</l>
         </lg>
      </quote> zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro || </seg></TEI>
